description: Create Triggers for the Project Webhook.

webhook_hook_id.description: Unique string identifier of the webhook hook this trigger belongs to. Use as the {hook_id} path parameter when managing triggers on that hook.

resource_name.description: Name of the Procore resource this trigger listens to (e.g., Work Orders, Project Users).

event_type.description: Event action that fires this trigger (e.g., create, update, delete).

company_id.description: Unique string identifier of the company this trigger is scoped to. Null for project-level triggers.

project_id.description: Unique string identifier of the project this trigger is scoped to. Null for company-level triggers.

resource_name.description: Name of the Procore resource to subscribe to (e.g., Work Orders, Company Users). Use the List Webhook Resources endpoint to discover valid values for your payload version.

event_type.description: Event action to subscribe to on the specified resource. Common values are create, update, delete. Use the List Webhook Resources endpoint to confirm supported event types per resource.
